title: Evidence viewer streamlined
details: Makes the Android evidence flow feel deliberate rather than broken: the large red browser warning is removed and replaced with a simple Open evidence ZIP step
Tapping an AC timestamp or recording on Android can now open the ZIP picker directly when file permission is still needed, then Milos continues to the selected recording automatically
Once the ZIP is loaded, the permission button and helper text disappear so only the video and evidence navigation remain
Desktop keeps automatic neighbouring-video loading, while both desktop and phone keep the fixed video with scrolling timestamp navigation
The exported viewer states clearly that evidence files stay on the device and are not uploaded
The proven Milos 2.46 camera/media stack and the reliable installed-app update handover are unchanged
